sinopsis.es: Maxine nunca ha tenido una relación. Lena nunca ha estado con otra mujer. Cuando Maxine le propone ser novias, Lena acepta con una sola preocupación: no se imagina teniendo sexo con una sola persona el resto de su vida.
sinopsis.en: Maxine's never been in a relationship. Lena's never been in a relationship with another woman. When Maxine asks her to be her girlfriend, Lena's all in with one concern: she doesn't see herself having sex with one person for the rest of her life.
